title: Team Ham Small Trivia Pack
description: Three categories with three ordinary text clues each. Required Final Jeoparty entries are reserved future content, not ordinary-board clues or implemented final-round gameplay.

scoring.notes: Ordinary clues use tiers 1, 2 and 3. The v2 contract also requires scoring for tiers 4 and 5; those tiers are unused in this sample. IDs do not determine points.

clues.prompt: Our home is this third planet from the Sun.
This gas giant is the largest planet in our solar system.
This moon of Saturn has a dense atmosphere and lakes of liquid methane and ethane.

finalJeoparty.notes: Reserved future content; not used by the ordinary 3x3 board.
finalJeoparty.prompt: Our solar system belongs to this galaxy, whose central supermassive black hole is called Sagittarius A*.

clues.prompt: The Eiffel Tower stands in this capital city of France.
This is Earth's largest ocean, lying between Asia and Australia to the west and the Americas to the east.
The ancient Inca site of Machu Picchu is in this South American country.

finalJeoparty.notes: Reserved future content; not used by the ordinary 3x3 board.
finalJeoparty.prompt: This narrow strait separates Spain from Morocco and connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea.
finalJeoparty.answer: What is the Strait of Gibraltar?

clues.prompt: This green fruit is the main ingredient in guacamole.
This Italian phrase describes pasta that is firm to the bite and literally means 'to the tooth'.
This spice comes from the dried stigmas of Crocus sativus flowers.

finalJeoparty.notes: Reserved future content; not used by the ordinary 3x3 board.
finalJeoparty.prompt: This reaction between amino acids and reducing sugars helps brown toasted bread and seared meat.
